title: OBC v1 On-Chain Memo
description: Schema for the OBC v1 JSON memo stored in a Solana transaction.

v.description: OBC standard version. Always '1' for this standard.

h.description: SHA-256 hex digest (lowercase, 64 chars) of the canonical off-chain JSON document.

a.description: HTTPS URL to the primary off-chain JSON document.

a1.description: HTTPS URL to the second off-chain JSON document (if multiple storage targets).

a2.description: HTTPS URL to the third off-chain JSON document (if multiple storage targets).

additionalProperties.description: Optional tenant-configured on-chain journal property fields.
